name: Read-write-read on a visible session counter in /tmp

submissions.reason: Show the previous value of the visible scratch counter at /tmp/intentframe-counter.txt when it exists, update it with the current epoch timestamp, then confirm the write. This read-write-read pattern is how shell scripts maintain named state files between invocations without hiding state under /var/root.

cleanup.reason: Remove the visible scratch session counter from /tmp.
